label: Watches your profile's chrome CSS and hot-reloads userChrome.css / userContent.css live on save - no browser restart needed.
Enable hot reload in this profile
description: Controls automatic watching and the manual reload hotkey for this Zen profile. Changes apply immediately.

label: Pause watcher
description: Temporarily stop polling and manual reload shortcuts without disabling the mod or losing watcher state. Resume to continue.

label: Reload userChrome.css
description: Reload browser chrome styles when a tracked CSS file changes or a manual reload is triggered.

label: Reload userContent.css
description: Reload styles in eligible open content documents and frames when a tracked CSS file changes or a manual reload is triggered.

label: Enable local debug logging
description: Log scan results, changed CSS files, reload outcomes, actor failures, and watcher handoffs to the Browser Console. Logs may contain local file paths; no data is sent remotely.

label: Custom Watch Path
description: Absolute path to one file or directory, or a JSON array of absolute paths for multiple roots (for example, ["/path/to/chrome", "/path/to/generated-css"]). Leave empty to use this profile's chrome directory.

label: Poll Interval (ms)
description: How often the file watcher checks for changes. Values are clamped to 200–5000 ms; default is 500 ms.

label: Reload Debounce (ms)
description: Wait after the latest detected change before reloading. Values are clamped to 50–2000 ms; default is 300 ms.

label: Watch nested directories
description: Also scan nested CSS directories. Directories listed in Excluded Directories are skipped. Disabled by default.

label: Excluded Directories
description: Comma-separated single directory names to skip while scanning CSS. Entries containing slashes or dot segments are ignored. Defaults to sine-mods,JS,utils; leave empty to exclude none.

label: Rebuild Sine mods too
description: Also calls Sine's manager.rebuildMods() so Sine-managed themes refresh in sync. CSS reload continues if Sine is unavailable.

label: Log reload status in Browser Console
description: Report a concise status message after each reload in the Browser Console. Disable to suppress these status messages.

label: Hotkey
description: Combo to force a reload anytime (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F5, F5, or Cmd+Shift+F5). Leave empty to disable.
